title: 3P IP Adapter: Frame
slide_intent: Derive framing shapes from familiar objects so unrelated content can still belong to the brand.
strategic_value: Serving-dish geometry can give Sweetgreen a recognizable way to organize varied imagery.
demonstration: Three photographs of a square dish, round dressing cup and six-sided bowl sit above matching square, circle and hexagon shapes.
practical_value: Relate a content frame to a physical brand object before applying it to outside imagery.

content_islands.name: Physical sources
content_islands.spec: Align the three food-vessel photographs across the upper row.

content_islands.name: Derived frames
content_islands.spec: Place one flat colored shape below each corresponding vessel.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying caption explains that shapes extracted from serving dishes help third-party content align with the brand.
reference_purposes.Application: The two rows explicitly connect vessel silhouettes to reusable content frames.
reference_purposes.Expression: Muted pink, green and blue distinguish three simple geometric containers.

ingredient.name: Serving-dish frames
ingredient.role: Give varied content a shared brand structure.
ingredient.application: Use the square, circular and six-sided silhouettes as content containers, following the illustrated derivation.
ingredient.scope: Source explains an adapter for third-party content; this board supplies no mandatory color values, corner radii or exclusive shape list.
